title: 凝视深渊：中国留学生海外连环迷奸案
title_en: Gazing into the Abyss: Serial Drug-Assisted Assaults by Chinese Students Abroad
eyebrow: True Crime & Social Issues · 真实犯罪与社会议题
summary_cn: 一句话概括：节目深度追踪邹正豪、徐超、张大鹏、蒋中毅、邵志婷等8名高学历中国留学生/海外华人在英、德、美实施的下药迷奸连环案，揭示「人设包装→社交约见→家中灌酒下药→性侵偷拍」的标准犯罪链条，以及Telegram「老司机驾校」等数千人中文群组如何形成跨国迷奸黑产网络——受害者几乎全为中国女性，已知受害者逾50人，而群组成员大多尚未受到法律制裁
summary_en: The show tracks eight highly educated Chinese students and overseas Chinese — Zou Zhenghao, Xu Chao, Zhang Dapeng, Jiang Zhongyi, Shao Zhiting, and others — accused of serial, drug-assisted assaults in the UK, Germany, and the US. It lays out the standard crime chain of persona-building, social dating, spiked drinks at home, and filmed assaults, plus the cross-border criminal ecosystem of Telegram groups like the 'Veteran Drivers' School' with thousands of members. Nearly all victims are Chinese women, with more than fifty known victims, while most group members remain unpunished.

scenes.title_cn: 一、邹正豪案：UCL博士的连环迷奸与6.5TB证据库
scenes.title_en: The Zou Zhenghao Case: A UCL PhD's Serial Assaults and a 6.5TB Evidence Archive
scenes.context: How an outwardly 'academic gentleman' built trust, committed the crimes, and how the case finally reached trial. 语域：formal 纪实报道 + 法律评论。
scenes.speak: Zou Zhenghao was born in 1997, studied a two-plus-two bachelor's at Guangdong University of Technology, and was a master's and PhD student in mechanical engineering at Queen's University Belfast and UCL. He showed off Rolexes, Louis Vuitton, and a gym-built physique, and claimed to have slept with over a hundred women — yet acquaintances described him as stingy, into fakes, and obsessed with bragging about his sexual prowess. The 'academic gentleman' image was a carefully crafted hunting tool: on first meetings he only talked math and kept his distance, building trust before plying drinks and drugs at parties. He met Chinese female students through dating apps, friends, or house parties, and invited them to his apartment for 'study discussions' or 'small gatherings.' He first reported nothing in May 2023 — actually, the first report was shelved because London police lacked translators and counseling; a second victim's successful report in January 2024 led to his arrest. The trial came in January 2025, where one victim, Xiaoyan, became one of only two women who helped secure the conviction.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：1997年生，广东工业大学2+2本科，贝尔法斯特女王大学+UCL机械工程硕博在读。对外展示劳力士、LV、健身身材，自称睡过100+女性；熟人评价却称其抠门、假货、爱炫耀性能力
sentences.en: The core mechanism: born in 1997, a two-plus-two bachelor's at Guangdong University of Technology, and a master's and PhD student in mechanical engineering at Queen's University Belfast and UCL. He showed off Rolexes, Louis Vuitton, and a gym physique, claimed to have slept with over a hundred women — while acquaintances described him as stingy, into fakes, and obsessed with bragging about his sexual prowess.
sentences.note: 表达提示mechanical engineering → 机械工程；sexual prowess → 性能力；acquaintances → 熟人；stingy → 抠门

sentences.cn: 关键理解：「学霸绅士」形象是精心设计的狩猎工具——首次见面只讨论数学、保持边界感，建立信任后才在派对上劝酒下药
sentences.en: The key insight: the 'academic gentleman' image was a carefully crafted hunting tool — first meetings only discussed math and maintained boundaries, building trust before the drinking and drugs at parties.
sentences.note: 表达提示crafted hunting tool → 精心设计的狩猎工具；maintain boundaries → 保持边界感；build trust → 建立信任

sentences.cn: 典型场景：通过社交软件/朋友介绍/轰趴局认识中国女留学生，以「学习讨论」或「小型派对」为由约到公寓
sentences.en: A typical scene: meeting Chinese female students through dating apps, friend referrals, or house parties, then inviting them to the apartment under the pretext of 'study discussions' or 'small gatherings.'
sentences.note: 表达提示dating apps → 社交软件；under the pretext of → 以…为由；house party → 轰趴

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「周正豪观察完后似乎并不满意小燕现在的状态，于是他开始不停的责备小燕，说他浪费了他的酒，一杯又一杯继续灌到小燕的嘴里」
sentences.en: 'After observing, Zhou Zhenghao seemed unsatisfied with Xiaoyan's state, so he kept blaming her for wasting his alcohol, pouring one glass after another down her throat.'
sentences.note: 表达提示pour … down one's throat → 灌进嘴里；blame sb for wasting → 责备浪费

sentences.cn: （引用）相关概念：与徐超案、蒋中毅案共享同一犯罪模板，均来自Telegram群组教程
sentences.en: Related concept: the same crime template appears in the Xu Chao and Jiang Zhongyi cases — all derived from the Telegram group tutorials.
sentences.note: 表达提示crime template → 犯罪模板；derive from → 源自；tutorial → 教程

sentences.cn: 2023年5月首次报警，因伦敦警方缺乏翻译和心理辅导而搁置；2024年1月另一位受害者成功报案后邹正豪被捕。2025年1月审判，小燕成为协助定罪的唯二出庭女性之一
sentences.en: The first report was made in May 2023 but was shelved because London police lacked translation and psychological support; after another victim successfully reported in January 2024, Zou was arrested. His trial took place in January 2025, and Xiaoyan became one of only two women who testified to help secure the conviction.
sentences.note: 表达提示shelved → 搁置；testify → 出庭作证；secure the conviction → 协助定罪

paraphrase.intent: 想说「精英人设是狩猎工具」
phrases: The scholar image was the hunting gear.
He weaponized his academic persona to lower guards.
paraphrase.chunks: hunting gear · weaponize a persona · lower guards
paraphrase.usage: weaponize 是新近高频率书面词，形容「把…用作武器」

paraphrase.intent: 想说「报案被搁置导致延误」
phrases: The first report was shelved for months.
Lack of support staff meant the case stalled.

scenes.title_cn: 二、徐超案：邹正豪判决后3个月的「复制粘贴」
scenes.title_en: The Xu Chao Case: A Copy-Paste Three Months After Zou's Conviction
scenes.context: How one conviction failed to deter a near-identical crime three months later, and its harsh sentence. 语域：formal 纪实报道 + 司法点评。
scenes.speak: Xu Chao, 33, came to the UK in 2013 and holds a master's from the University of Greenwich. Spotting students' job-hunting struggles and visa troubles, he lured women with promises of 'internal recommendations' for jobs, then drugged and assaulted them in his apartment, filming large amounts of video. Less than three months after Zou Zhenghao was sentenced to life in March 2025, Xu continued with almost identical methods — showing that individual punishment cannot dismantle a group-driven crime culture. He was sentenced to life imprisonment, with a minimum of thirteen years and two hundred days before the parole board's first review, followed by lifetime police notification and a possible deportation to China. He even edited multiple assault videos into a single compilation. There were over thirteen known victims, including Xiaoye, who accompanied another victim to report and was assaulted herself. One survivor, Xiaoxue, couldn't work normally after landing a job due to trauma and now avoids all men; Xiaoye fears sleep, her videos leaking, and retaliation.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：33岁，2013年来英，格林威治大学硕士。发现留学生求职难、签证困境，以「帮忙内推」为诱饵接近女性，在公寓下药性侵并拍摄大量视频
sentences.en: The core mechanism: Xu Chao, 33, arrived in the UK in 2013 and holds a master's from the University of Greenwich. Spotting students' difficulty finding jobs and their visa troubles, he lured women with promises of 'internal referrals,' then drugged and assaulted them in his apartment while filming a large amount of video.
sentences.note: 表达提示internal referral → 内推；visa trouble → 签证困境；lure women → 诱饵接近女性

sentences.cn: 关键理解：2025年3月邹正豪被判无期后不到3个月，徐超以几乎相同手法继续犯罪——说明个体刑罚无法瓦解群组驱动的犯罪文化
sentences.en: The key insight: less than three months after Zou Zhenghao's life sentence in March 2025, Xu continued with nearly identical methods — individual punishment alone cannot dismantle a group-driven crime culture.
sentences.note: 表达提示life sentence → 无期徒刑；dismantle a crime culture → 瓦解犯罪文化；group-driven → 群组驱动的

sentences.cn: 判决：无期徒刑，假释委员会首次审理前最低服刑13年200天；刑满后需终身向警方通报个人信息，满刑后可能被驱逐回中国
sentences.en: The sentence: life imprisonment, with a minimum of thirteen years and 200 days before the parole board's first review; after release, lifetime police notification, and possibly deportation to China once the term ends.
sentences.note: 表达提示parole board → 假释委员会；deportation → 驱逐；lifetime police notification → 终身通报警方

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「徐超甚至还会把多个不同的性侵视频剪辑在一起，做成合集混剪的样子」——13+已知受害者，含陪同报案却同样受害的小叶
sentences.en: 'Xu Chao would even cut multiple assault videos together into a compilation' — with more than thirteen known victims, including Xiaoye, who accompanied another victim to report and was assaulted herself.
sentences.note: 表达提示compilation → 合集；known victims → 已知受害者；accompany … to report → 陪同报案

sentences.cn: 小雪：找到工作后因创伤无法正常工作，远离所有男性；小叶：不敢睡觉，害怕视频流出和被报复；两人均不敢告诉家人，小雪为曾介绍朋友给徐超而深深自责
sentences.en: Xiaoxue, after finding work, couldn't function normally due to trauma and now stays away from all men; Xiaoye is afraid to sleep, terrified of the videos leaking and of retaliation. Neither dared tell their families, and Xiaoxue still blames herself for having introduced a friend to Xu.
sentences.note: 表达提示trauma → 创伤；retaliation → 报复；blame oneself → 自责

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：若朋友出现异常「断片失忆」且与某男性独处后发生，应优先怀疑药物侵害而非「喝多了」，鼓励其保留证据并联系当地性侵专线（英国可拨打999或Rape Crisis）
sentences.en: How to respond: if a friend experiences unexplained 'blackout memory loss' after being alone with a man, suspect drug involvement rather than 'she just drank too much' — encourage preserving evidence and contacting the local sexual assault helpline (in the UK, dial 999 or reach out to Rape Crisis).
sentences.note: 表达提示blackout memory loss → 断片失忆；preserve evidence → 保留证据；sexual assault helpline → 性侵求助专线

paraphrase.intent: 想说「判决没能阻止复制犯罪」
phrases: The conviction didn't stop a copycat.
Punishing one man left the culture intact.
paraphrase.chunks: a copycat · leave the culture intact
paraphrase.usage: copycat 专指模仿犯案，新闻常用

paraphrase.intent: 想说「朋友断片要先怀疑药物」
phrases: Suspect drugs, not just 'too much to drink.'
Blackout after being alone with someone is a red flag.
paraphrase.usage: red flag 是「危险信号」的标准说法

scenes.title_cn: 三、Telegram黑产网络：从张大鹏到「德国老司机驾校」
scenes.title_en: The Telegram Crime Network: From Zhang Dapeng to the 'German Veterans' Driving School'
scenes.context: The transnational drug-and-crime ecosystem, and the doctors and logistics managers behind it. 语域：formal 纪实调查 + 法律评论。
scenes.speak: The 'three-piece kit' needs professional anesthesia monitoring — group members combining them on their own can cause respiratory depression and death. In the Xiaohua case, three drugs were used together; any single one requires a doctor's supervision throughout. Zhang Dapeng has a Harbin Institute of Technology background and a computer science master's from Tübingen, and ran twenty-five Telegram groups, the largest with 2,316 members. In 2022 he used the three-piece kit on his Airbnb host Xiaohua; with over ten victims, he received fourteen years plus preventive detention under Germany's combined sentencing, far lighter than in the UK. Jiang Zhongyi, 28, a robotics master's from the Technical University of Munich, repeatedly drugged his neighbor Xiaolan — she suspected a mental problem from the blackouts, never suspected him, and once said she might kill herself. Xu Xu Kaiyuan, a cross-border logistics manager, was the core smuggler bringing triazolam from China to distribute in Germany; he died by suicide while in custody in December 2024, halting the supply-chain investigation. There was also Shao Zhiting, born 1993, a model medical student and devout Buddhist on the surface — studying at Hebei Medical University, Peking University People's Hospital, and Charité Berlin, researching invasive cancer cells.

sentences.cn: 适用边界：三件套需专业麻醉监护，群友自行组合使用可致呼吸抑制死亡——受害者小花案例中三种药物叠加使用，任意一种单独使用都需医生全程监护
sentences.en: The boundary: the three-piece kit requires professional anesthesia monitoring — members combining them on their own risks respiratory depression and death. In the Xiaohua case three drugs were stacked, and any single one of them requires a doctor's full supervision.
sentences.note: 表达提示three-piece kit → 三件套（麻醉药物组合）；respiratory depression → 呼吸抑制；stack drugs → 叠加用药

sentences.cn: 张大鹏：哈工大背景，德国图宾根计算机硕士，Telegram 25个迷奸群、最大群2316人。2022年对Airbnb房东小花下药三件套，10+受害者，判14年+预防羁押（德国合并量刑原则，远低于英国）
sentences.en: Zhang Dapeng: a Harbin Institute of Technology background, a computer science master's from Tübingen, and twenty-five Telegram assault groups, the largest with 2,316 members. In 2022 he drugged his Airbnb host Xiaohua with the three-piece kit, and with more than ten victims received fourteen years plus preventive detention under Germany's combined-sentencing principle — far lighter than the UK.
sentences.note: 表达提示combined sentencing → 合并量刑；preventive detention → 预防羁押；far lighter than → 远低于

sentences.cn: 蒋中毅：慕尼黑工大机器人学硕士，28岁，对邻居小兰反复下药——小兰因「断片失忆」怀疑自己有精神问题，从未怀疑过蒋中毅，甚至说过「可能有一天会自杀」
sentences.en: Jiang Zhongyi: a 28-year-old robotics master's from the Technical University of Munich who repeatedly drugged his neighbor Xiaolan — she blamed her blackout memory loss on a possible mental problem, never suspected him, and even said she might one day kill herself.
sentences.note: 表达提示robotics master's → 机器人学硕士；blame … on → 把…归咎于；never suspected him → 从未怀疑过他

sentences.cn: 徐徐开员：跨境物流经理，核心职责是从中国走私三唑仑到德国分发，2024年12月羁押期间畏罪自杀，供应链调查被迫终止
sentences.en: Xu Xu Kaiyuan: a cross-border logistics manager whose core role was smuggling triazolam from China into Germany for distribution; he died by suicide while in custody in December 2024, and the supply-chain investigation was forced to stop.
sentences.note: 表达提示cross-border logistics → 跨境物流；smuggle → 走私；die by suicide in custody → 羁押期间自杀

sentences.cn: 原因：1993年生，河北医科大学→北大人民医院硕士→柏林夏里特医院博士（研究方向：侵袭性癌细胞），表面是模范医学生+虔诚佛教徒
sentences.en: The reason: born in 1993, from Hebei Medical University to a master's at Peking University People's Hospital to a PhD at Berlin's Charité (researching invasive cancer cells) — on the surface, a model medical student and a devout Buddhist.
sentences.note: 表达提示devout Buddhist → 虔诚佛教徒；invasive cancer cells → 侵袭性癌细胞；on the surface → 表面

sentences.cn: 实际：2022年9月起即为群友提供下药建议（「喂她两片药她就不会记得任何事」）；2019-2021在中国对未婚妻实施至少5次迷奸；群聊中按受害者体重计算用药剂量（「车有多重？53公斤」）
sentences.en: In reality: from September 2022 he was advising group members on drugs ('feed her two pills and she won't remember anything'); between 2019 and 2021 he drugged his own fiancée in China at least five times; in the group chats he calculated doses by victims' body weight.
sentences.note: 表达提示in reality → 实际；calculate the dose → 计算用药剂量；body weight → 体重

paraphrase.intent: 想说「表面人设与实际行为完全相反」
phrases: His public persona was the polar opposite of his actions.
The devout exterior concealed a systematic predator.
paraphrase.usage: polar opposite 强调完全相反；conceal 偏书面

paraphrase.intent: 想说「供应链调查被迫中断」
phrases: The probe ground to a halt.
The supply-chain investigation hit a dead end.
paraphrase.chunks: grind to a halt · hit a dead end
paraphrase.usage: grind to a halt 形象；hit a dead end 口语

scenes.title_cn: 四、三国司法对比与翁思哲美国案
scenes.title_en: Comparing Three Legal Systems, and the Weng Sizhe Case in the US
scenes.context: Why drug-assault victims stay silent, differences in evidence rules across countries, and concrete reporting steps. 语域：formal 普法 + 司法比较。
scenes.speak: Drug-assault victims often don't report because of missing memories plus a culture of self-blame — 'maybe I shouldn't have gone to his place.' In the Zou case, the first reporter's claim sat shelved for almost eight months over translation issues, during which the crimes continued. Evidence rules differ by country — German courts can exercise jurisdiction over crimes committed abroad, as in Shao Zhiting's case against his fiancée in China, but witnesses can claim spousal privilege and refuse to testify, causing key evidence to vanish. If you suspect you've been drugged: get a urine or blood test as soon as possible, since most date-rape drugs are detectable within twenty-four to seventy-two hours; don't shower, change clothes, or throw away the drink cup; ask for a Chinese interpreter or contact Chinese women's organizations; and even if the first report fails, warn others through social media — Xiaoyan's Xiaohongshu post became a crucial whistleblowing record.

sentences.cn: 为什么重要：药物性侵受害者常因记忆缺失+自责文化（「是不是我不该去他家」）而不报案——邹正豪案第一位报警者因翻译问题搁置近8个月，期间犯罪仍在继续
sentences.en: Why it matters: victims of drug-assisted assault often stay silent because of missing memory plus a self-blame culture — 'maybe I shouldn't have gone to his apartment.' The first reporter in the Zou case saw her claim shelved for nearly eight months over translation issues, during which the crimes continued.
sentences.note: 表达提示self-blame culture → 自责文化；shelve → 搁置；translation issues → 翻译问题

sentences.cn: 适用边界：不同国家证据规则不同——德国法院可对境外犯罪行使管辖权（邵志婷中国境内对未婚妻案件），但证人可行使亲属拒绝作证权导致关键证据缺失
sentences.en: The boundary: evidence rules differ by country — German courts can exercise jurisdiction over crimes committed abroad, as in the Shao Zhiting case involving his fiancée in China, but witnesses can claim the right to refuse testimony and deprive the case of key evidence.
sentences.note: 表达提示exercise jurisdiction → 行使管辖权；spousal privilege → 亲属拒绝作证权；deprive … of key evidence → 导致关键证据缺失

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：① 怀疑被下药后尽快验尿/验血（多数迷药24-72小时内可检出）；② 不洗澡、不换衣、保留饮料杯；③ 要求中文翻译或联系华人妇女组织协助；④ 即使首次报案失败，可通过社交媒体警示他人（小燕的小红书笔记成为关键吹哨）
sentences.en: How to respond: ① get a urine or blood test as soon as you suspect you've been drugged — most date-rape drugs are detectable within 24 to 72 hours; ② don't shower, change clothes, or throw away the drink cup; ③ request a Chinese interpreter or contact Chinese women's organizations; ④ even if the first report fails, alert others through social media — Xiaoyan's Xiaohongshu post became a crucial whistleblowing record.
sentences.note: 表达提示urine / blood test → 验尿/验血；date-rape drug → 迷药；detectable → 可检出；whistleblowing → 吹哨

paraphrase.intent: 想说「第一次报案失败不等于无路可走」
phrases: A rejected report isn't the end of the road.
Even a failed first report can still warn others.
paraphrase.chunks: the end of the road · warn others
paraphrase.usage: the end of the road 是地道说法

paraphrase.intent: 想说「不洗澡不换衣保留证据」
phrases: Don't shower or change — preserve the evidence.
Keep the cup and your clothes as they are.
paraphrase.chunks: preserve the evidence · keep … as they are
paraphrase.usage: preserve 是法律语境标准动词

scenes.title_cn: 五、识别危险信号：如何警惕身边的「邹正豪」
scenes.title_en: Spotting the Red Flags: How to Watch for the 'Zou Zhenghao' Around You
scenes.context: Why public personas deceive, why victims feel alone, and the moral question around silent group members. 语域：formal 社会评论 + 节目反思。
scenes.speak: The guests note that Xu Xu Kaiyuan was praised online as unusually empathetic and respectful of women — among the rare men who truly understand women. Public persona and private behavior can be complete opposites; you can't judge safety by social performance alone. Every victim believed 'I'm the only one' — until they connected and found a systematic crime. Twenty-three women came forward after the Zou verdict, and the seats at Shao Zhiting's hearing were packed with Chinese women who had traveled from Frankfurt. The show honestly notes that whether 'just reading messages without committing crimes' is illegal remains unanswered — but thousands of group members have indeed gone unpunished. 'We came here so she can feel we're all watching her,' a woman in the Shao Zhiting gallery told a reporter in May 2026. And when a woman discovers her partner is in an assault group, even if only watching and saying nothing, a female friend's answer was, 'what else can you do — you can't break up over that, right?' — and that tolerance of bystanders is exactly the problem.

sentences.cn: （引用）嘉宾说法：「徐徐开员在朋友圈被夸特别有同理心、尊重女性——男性里面少有的真正共情女性的代表」——公开人设与私密行为可以完全相反，不可仅凭社交表现判断安全
sentences.en: The guests' point: Xu Xu Kaiyuan was praised online as especially empathetic and respectful toward women — 'a rare man who truly empathizes with women.' A public persona and private behavior can be complete opposites; you cannot judge someone's safety by social performance alone.
sentences.note: 表达提示empathetic → 有同理心；public persona → 公开人设；judge by social performance → 仅凭社交表现判断

sentences.cn: 为什么重要：每个受害者都以为「只有我一个人」——直到互联才发现是系统性犯罪。邹正豪案23位女性在判决后继续站出来，邵志婷庭审旁听席挤满从法兰克福赶来的中国女性
sentences.en: Why it matters: every victim believed 'I'm the only one' — until they connected the dots and found a systematic crime. Twenty-three women came forward after the Zou verdict, and the gallery at Shao Zhiting's hearing was packed with Chinese women who had traveled from Frankfurt.
sentences.note: 表达提示connect the dots → 串联线索；come forward → 站出来；systematic crime → 系统性犯罪

sentences.cn: 适用边界：节目也诚实指出：「只是看消息没犯罪是否犯法——这个问题暂时无法解答」，但数千群成员确实尚未受到任何惩罚
sentences.en: The boundary: the show honestly notes that the question of whether 'only reading messages without committing crimes' is illegal remains unanswered — yet thousands of group members have indeed received no punishment.
sentences.note: 表达提示remain unanswered → 无法解答；unpunished → 未受惩罚

sentences.cn: （引用）「我们现在过来，就是为了让她感受到，我们都在看着她。」——2026年5月邵志婷案旁听席女性对记者说的话
sentences.en: 'We came here so that she can feel that we are all watching her.' — a woman in the gallery at Shao Zhiting's hearing, speaking to a reporter in May 2026.
sentences.note: 表达提示gallery → 旁听席；watching her → 看着她

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：若发现伴侣在迷奸群组中（即使「只看不说」），节目引用女性朋友回答：「那还能怎么样，总不能因为这个分手吧」——这正是问题所在：对旁观者的宽容会纵容犯罪生态扩张
sentences.en: How to respond: when a woman discovers her partner is in one of these groups, even if he only watches and says nothing, the show quotes a female friend's answer: 'what else can we do — we can't break up over that, right?' — and that tolerance of bystanders is exactly what lets the criminal ecosystem expand.
sentences.note: 表达提示bystander → 旁观者；tolerance → 宽容；expand the ecosystem → 纵容犯罪生态扩张

paraphrase.intent: 想说「每个受害者都以为只有自己」
phrases: Every victim thought she was the only one.
Isolation is what the system depends on.
paraphrase.usage: the only one 保留原文情感；isolation 是分析视角

paraphrase.intent: 想说「对旁观者的宽容是纵容」
phrases: Tolerating the bystanders feeds the machine.
Turning a blind eye is part of the problem.
paraphrase.chunks: feed the machine · turn a blind eye
paraphrase.usage: turn a blind eye 是「视而不见」的惯用说法

practice.cn: 用「red flag」说：独自相处后断片是危险信号。
practice.en: Blacking out after being alone with someone is a serious red flag — suspect drugs, not 'too much to drink.'

practice.cn: 用「preserve evidence」说：不要洗澡换衣，保留证据。
practice.en: Don't shower or change clothes — preserve the evidence and get tested within 72 hours.

practice.cn: 用「connect the dots」说：互联之后才发现是系统性犯罪。
practice.en: Only after they connected the dots did the victims realize it was a systematic crime.

practice.cn: 用「come forward」说：判决后 23 位女性站出来。
practice.en: Twenty-three women came forward after the verdict — none of them had known they weren't alone.

pitfalls.wrong: She lost memory because she drank too much.
pitfalls.right: The blackout memory loss is a red flag for drug involvement, not just over-drinking.
pitfalls.why: 断片不一定是喝多；drug involvement 才是要优先排除的，直译会忽略危险信号。

pitfalls.wrong: He is a good man because he respects women.
pitfalls.right: A public persona of empathy says nothing about private behavior.
pitfalls.why: 凭公开表现判断安全是危险的；persona vs private behavior 的对立才是要点。

pitfalls.wrong: Only people who do crimes should be punished.
pitfalls.right: Tolerating silent bystanders is what lets the criminal ecosystem expand.
pitfalls.why: 节目关键论点正是「旁观者宽容」也是问题；照搬常识反而错过讨论重点。

pitfalls.wrong: The police put her report away.
pitfalls.right: The report was shelved for months because police lacked translators and counseling support.
pitfalls.why: 「搁置」不是故意藏案；shelved + 原因解释才能准确描述制度性延误。

shifts.before: 以为「学霸绅士」人设代表可信
shifts.after: 人设是狩猎工具——公开表现与私密行为可以完全相反

shifts.before: 以为个人被判重刑就能终结犯罪
shifts.after: 群组驱动的犯罪文化需要系统性瓦解，单点判决远远不够

shifts.before: 以为「只看不说」的旁观者无罪
shifts.after: 对旁观者的宽容会纵容犯罪生态扩张——看见本身就在参与
